facts.fact: Cabinet approved the Seychelles National Addressing System Bill, 2026, a framework for a standardised, digitally enabled national addressing system with a National Addressing Department and a National Addressing Database Unit, per State House.
Vice President Pillay said Seychelles has no proper addressing system and that the postcode in use is simply four zeros.

slug: 2025-01-01 National Addressing System - Seychelles Postal Regulator

facts.fact: The Seychelles Postal Regulator says Cabinet approved implementing a National Addressing and Postcode System and adopted the S42 address standard, with the legal framework still being drafted.

Cabinet approved in principle the National Addressing System Bill, 2026 and a National Addressing System Department under the Ministry of Local Government and Inner Islands, to be submitted to the National Assembly, per State House.
